svg.title: Single-Life Learning paradigm diagram
svg.desc: Figure inventory: three horizontal rows with photo experience cards on the left, person icons, individual data cylinders D1-D3, learned model parameter boxes theta-star_1 to theta-star_3, arrows to single-life representation boxes containing simple geometric shapes, a dashed right-side grouping brace, a gray question callout, and a rounded explanatory callout. Row layout is vertically equipartitioned; within each row the relation proceeds left-to-right from experience to data to model to representation. Confirmed SAM assets are mapped after full SVG construction: top/middle/bottom photos to their photo crops; representation composite boxes to their corresponding crop assets.

g.desc: Each gray card contains a stacked photo block at left and a three-dot ellipsis at right; the three cards are aligned vertically and evenly spaced.
Rows are horizontally symmetric in process order: photo experience, person glyph, D_i cylinder, theta_i-star model box, dashed arrow, representation.
The three representation rows are visually grouped by a dashed vertical brace to the right, leading to questions about alignment and generalization.
Gray callout lists two questions: model alignment and model generalization.
Rounded explanatory box states the Single-Life Learning paradigm: individual models trained on individual's data.
Original top experience photo - constructed element draft_photo_top - SAM asset asset_sam_region_000034; crop covers the photograph block, not the gray card or ellipsis.
Original middle experience photo - constructed element draft_photo_mid - SAM asset asset_sam_region_000033; crop covers the main dark hands/camera image, not the gray card or ellipsis.
Original bottom experience photo - constructed element draft_photo_bottom - SAM asset asset_sam_region_000035; crop covers the lab/table photo block, not the gray card or ellipsis.
Top representation composite - constructed elements f04 and draft_rep1 - SAM asset asset_sam_region_000017; crop covers the rounded representation box and its internal shapes.
Middle representation composite - constructed elements f05 and draft_rep2 - SAM asset asset_sam_region_000015; crop covers the rounded representation box and its internal shapes.
Bottom representation composite - constructed elements f06 and draft_rep3 - SAM asset asset_sam_region_000016; crop covers the rounded representation box and its internal shapes.
